mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.name,c.environment_id,c.description,c.draft_revision,c.active_revision, c.enabled,c.state_version,c.updated_at,r.metadata_type,r.discovery_mode,r.provider_metadata_mode FROM dubbo_connection c LEFT JOIN dubbo_connection_revision r ON r.connection_id = c.id AND r.revision = COALESCE(c.active_revision,c.draft_revision) WHERE c.environment_id = #{environmentId} AND c.name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' AND c.enabled = true AND c.active_revision IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC,c.id DESC
